description: Source file containing unit tests for the AgentWorkspace component, verifying functions related to path display, URL resolution, bootstrap processes, and safety checks within a testing suite.

methods.name: display path uses tilde for home
methods.description: Tests if the displayPath function correctly represents the home directory with a tilde (~).

methods.name: resolve workspace URL expands tilde
methods.description: Verifies that resolveWorkspaceURL correctly expands a tilde-based path to an absolute URL with the expected suffix.

methods.name: agents URL appends filename
methods.description: Checks if the agentsURL function correctly appends the filename to the workspace URL.

methods.name: bootstrap creates agents file when missing
methods.description: Ensures that the bootstrap method creates necessary agent files and returns the correct URL when called on a missing workspace.

methods.name: bootstrap safety rejects non empty folder without agents
methods.description: Validates that bootstrapSafety identifies an unsafe workspace when it contains unrecognized files.

methods.name: bootstrap safety allows existing agents file
methods.description: Ensures that bootstrapSafety considers a workspace safe if it contains a valid agents file.

methods.name: bootstrap skips bootstrap file when workspace has content
methods.description: Verifies that bootstrap does not re-initialize when the workspace has other content.

methods.name: needs bootstrap false when identity already set
methods.description: Checks that the function correctly returns false when the identity file already exists in the workspace.
